name: Data Analyzer: Upload a dictionary, save it, then fetch it back by its ID
objective: Shows the two-step workflow works: a dictionary is parsed and saved, and the saved program can be retrieved with matching details.
precondition: Server application loaded in the offline test harness with a made-up API key configured; the application is reloaded for this group of tests. Dictionary storage is replaced by a stand-in where stated, so no AI model is called. Dictionary storage is replaced by a stand-in returning a canned, made-up program record. The test is skipped if the service is unavailable (503).

steps.action: Upload a made-up REDCap dictionary CSV (8 fields) with save_program true and program name 'PatientIntake'.
steps.expected: HTTP 200. The reply contains program_id, program_name, fields_extracted and rules_extracted.

steps.action: Fetch the dictionary by the returned program ID.
steps.expected: HTTP 200. program_id matches; num_fields equals fields_extracted; schema and generated_code are present.

name: Data Analyzer: Upload a dictionary in preview mode (not saved) is accepted
objective: Shows that the preview option works. Only the status is checked; the test does not verify nothing was saved.
precondition: Server application loaded in the offline test harness with a made-up API key configured; the application is reloaded for this group of tests. Dictionary storage is replaced by a stand-in where stated, so no AI model is called. Dictionary storage is replaced by a stand-in returning a canned, made-up program record. Skipped if the service is unavailable.

steps.action: Upload the made-up dictionary CSV with save_program false.

name: Data Analyzer: Health check reports 'degraded' whenever any internal service is down
objective: Shows the health status honestly reflects missing services. Note: if all services are up the check asserts nothing.
precondition: Server application loaded in the offline test harness with a made-up API key configured; the application is reloaded for this group of tests. Dictionary storage is replaced by a stand-in where stated, so no AI model is called.

steps.expected: HTTP 200; and, only if any service is not available, the status is 'degraded'.

steps.expected: Every reply is HTTP 200 and contains status.

name: Data Analyzer: A 10,000-field dictionary does not crash the server (very weak check)
objective: Shows only that a large upload receives some answer. The test accepts nearly any status including 500 and does not stub the AI step.
precondition: Server application loaded in the offline test harness with a made-up API key configured; the application is reloaded for this group of tests. Dictionary storage is replaced by a stand-in where stated, so no AI model is called. Dictionary storage is NOT stubbed in this test.

steps.expected: HTTP status is one of 200, 400, 413, 500 or 503.

name: Data Analyzer: An empty dictionary file gives HTTP 500 with a fixed error message
objective: Shows that when processing an empty dictionary fails, the API returns a controlled error with a generic message rather than success.
precondition: Server application loaded in the offline test harness with a made-up API key configured; the application is reloaded for this group of tests. Dictionary storage is replaced by a stand-in where stated, so no AI model is called. Dictionary storage is set to fail with 'No fields could be extracted'.

steps.expected: HTTP 500 exactly, and the error text is exactly 'Dictionary parsing failed.'. The failure comes from the stand-in, so this tests error handling, not the real parser.
